Decode a labelled import by its value labels, by code

Source: R/categorical_guard.R
declbld.Rd

Converts a vector read from SPSS, Stata or SAS (for example by haven::read_sav()), which stores categories as numeric codes with a labels attribute, into a factor of the labels. Each code is looked up by its value, so neither the order of the codes nor the alphabetical order of the labels can affect which label a row gets. Codes with no label are refused. The factor's levels are in code order, which keeps the source program's reference category.

Usage

declbld(x, vlabs = NULL)

Arguments

x

A vector with a labels attribute (as produced by haven), or a plain vector of codes when vlabs is supplied.

vlabs

Optional named character vector, code = label, used only when x carries no labels attribute. Default NULL.

Value

A factor whose levels are the labels in code order (not alphabetical), with a recode_audit attribute as described in grdrcd.

Details

When x has a labels attribute (a named vector, label = code) it is used and vlabs is ignored; otherwise vlabs (code = label) is required. Decoding is done by deccodes. The levels are the labels ordered by their numeric code (codes that are not numbers are ordered after the numeric ones, by string), and include labels of codes that do not occur.

Errors: a labels attribute without names; no attribute and no vlabs; a code with no label.

See also

deccodes, relbl, xfrvrf

Examples

x <- structure(c(1, 2, 2, 4),
               labels = c(White = 1, Black = 2, Other = 3, Unknown = 4))
declbld(x)
#> [1] White   Black   Black   Unknown
#> attr(,"recode_audit")
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$mapping
#>       1       2       3       4 
#>   White   Black   Other Unknown 
#> 
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$kept
#> character(0)
#> 
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$checksum
#> [1] 3d394c3d6f779a313f8fbeecaf5bc4f104738096c07f03c48ab68d5eb52e8de4
#> 
#> Levels: White Black Other Unknown

# plain codes with a code book; levels follow the codes 1, 2, 10
declbld(c(2, 1, 10), vlabs = c("10" = "Ten", "2" = "Two", "1" = "One"))
#> [1] Two One Ten
#> attr(,"recode_audit")
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$mapping
#>  10   2   1 
#> Ten Two One 
#> 
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$kept
#> character(0)
#> 
#> attr(,"recode_audit")$checksum
#> [1] 04b601fcdea59b8af2b9872c344ef20fe46363eb3f2dab525ba486cb22d8ecaf
#> 
#> Levels: One Two Ten

# codes alone are not categories
try(declbld(c(1, 2, 2)))
#> Error : declbld: `x` carries no `labels` attribute and `vlabs` was not supplied; the codes alone are NOT the categories
